primary_error.message: The inspection/source-join phase exceeded its 20000 ms command_timeout_ms deadline (deadlineExpired). This is not the caller observation window, not the 10000 ms CDP discovery deadline, and not the 5000 ms cleanup grace.

remediation.action: Increase command_timeout_ms above 20000 (integer milliseconds from 1 to 2147483647; omitted means 20000), or use --command-timeout-ms on the CLI. Applies on the next call. Allow execution, cleanup and delivery headroom in the outer MCP client deadline. Confirm outstanding work and cleanup before retrying. command_timeout_ms does not raise the fixed protocol, retained-event, or source byte budgets, the 10000 ms CDP discovery response deadline, or the 5000 ms cleanup grace. Those have no runtime override.
